snapshot.honestLine: Cash on hand is tight right now, on purpose. It goes back into the two engines the moment it lands. Here is the full picture, deal by deal, dollar by dollar.
snapshot.loanContext: You floated the first $9,000. This is the accounting you are owed, built so you can check every number against a real closing, plus exactly where the next $9,000 goes.

depositProof.label: Every one matches a deposit and a Closing Disclosure
depositProof.text: These are not estimates. Each commission comes off a signed Closing Disclosure (Kane Jeffries, Caplan Law, Rocket Close) and lands as a deposit in the business account, from Long & Foster earlier in the year and Samson Properties now. A couple of additional closings are still being matched on top of these.

ask.headline: One more $9,000, earmarked for AG ads.
roiLogic: AG ad spend so far: about $4,750 produced 42 leads and $103,100 of weighted pipeline.
That is roughly $113 a lead and about $21 of pipeline for every $1 of ad spend.
A single AG facilitation pays $10,000 to $30,000. One deal covers the $9,000 several times over.
The MAMS side already proves I execute. Nine closings on signed disclosures this year is the evidence, not a promise.
ask.close: This is not a rescue. It is fuel for the fastest, most repeatable lane, from someone who has already shown the model works.
